# Psalm 118 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Give-thanks to-YHWH for good, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**2** Let-say now Israel, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**3** Let-say now house-of Aaron, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**4** Let-say now fearers-of YHWH, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

**5** From-the-straits I-called Yah; answered-me in-the-broad-place Yah.

**6** YHWH for-me, not I-will-fear; what can-do to-me man?

**7** YHWH for-me among-my-helpers, and-I will-look on-those-hating-me.

**8** Better to-take-refuge in-YHWH than-to-trust in-man.

**9** Better to-take-refuge in-YHWH than-to-trust in-princes.

**10** All nations surrounded-me; in-name-of YHWH surely I-cut-them-off.

**11** They-surrounded-me, also they-surrounded-me; in-name-of YHWH surely I-cut-them-off.

**12** They-surrounded-me like-bees; they-were-extinguished like-fire-of thorns; in-name-of YHWH surely I-cut-them-off.

**13** Pushing you-pushed-me to-fall, and-YHWH helped-me.

**14** My-strength and-song Yah, and-he-has-become to-me salvation.

**15** Voice-of singing and-salvation in-tents-of the-righteous; right-hand-of YHWH does valiantly.

**16** Right-hand-of YHWH is-exalted; right-hand-of YHWH does valiantly.

**17** Not I-will-die but I-will-live, and-I-will-recount the-deeds-of Yah.

**18** Disciplining has-disciplined-me Yah, and-to-death not he-has-given-me.

**19** Open to-me gates-of righteousness; I-will-enter them, I-will-give-thanks to-Yah.

**20** This the-gate to-YHWH; the-righteous will-enter in-it.

**21** I-will-give-thanks-to-you for you-have-answered-me, and-you-have-become to-me salvation.

**22** The-stone the-builders rejected has-become the-head-of the-corner.

**23** From YHWH this has-been; it-is wonderful in-our-eyes.

**24** This the-day YHWH has-made; let-us-rejoice and-be-glad in-it.

**25** O YHWH save please! O YHWH prosper please!

**26** Blessed the-one-coming in-name-of YHWH; we-bless-you from-house-of YHWH.

**27** God YHWH and-he-has-given-light to-us; bind the-festival-offering with-cords to the-horns-of the-altar.

**28** My-God you-are and-I-will-give-thanks-to-you; my-God I-will-exalt-you.

**29** Give-thanks to-YHWH for good, for to-forever his-steadfast-love.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **118:22**: 'The-stone the-builders rejected' — cited by Jesus (Matt 21:42), Peter (Acts 4:11, 1 Pet 2:7), and Paul (Eph 2:20). The rejected one becomes the cornerstone.

- **118:25**: Hoshi'ah-na' ('save please!') = 'Hosanna' — the cry of the crowd at Jesus' triumphal entry (Matt 21:9).

- **118:26**: 'Blessed the-one-coming in-name-of YHWH' — Passover processional greeting, applied to Jesus at the triumphal entry.

— EMET
